en-US.description: Installer for the Parley Deck multi-agent cooperation skill.
en-US.longDescription: Installs the vendor-neutral Parley Deck AI cooperation skill into Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, legacy Gemini CLI, Hermes, Kimi Code, or a custom skill directory. v2.2.0 gives every packaged skill a byte-exact integrity manifest, so an install placed by any installer can be verified file by file. This closes four defects in 2.1.0. Installing all six skills with a third-party installer reported five of them malformed even when every byte was correct, because only one skill shipped a manifest. A skill installed by this tool and then gutted down to a single file reported healthy, and that verdict survived the upgrade for installs made earlier. The core skill accepted the deletion of files it had itself installed without reporting anything. And health could report a directory as unowned while removal treated it as owned. Note for existing users, doctor will report your add-ons malformed until you re-run install once; force is not needed. Integrity checking here is defect detection, not tamper resistance.
en-US.name: Parley Deck Skill
